summary: Connect reusable Snake and Maze Chase logic to host-side trusted-owner session actions and generate row-major 32x16 RGB frames for future Matrix integration.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: User request in the Cart Upgrades project on 2026-10-12 explicitly requires integrating existing deterministic Snake/Maze runtimes, secure session-bound phone input, and 32x16 rendering; work remains offline.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Host arcade session/input/frame orchestration only. Caller-supplied owner/pair context is trusted input, not authentication. This does not add a transport, firmware frame receiver, backend deployment, or live device action; it does not establish a playable integrated game.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert hbnf-cart-core/domain/arcade-controller.mjs, tests/hbnf-arcade-runtime.mjs changes, and this record. Existing firmware and installed R6 remain untouched.
evidence_sources: Pinned WLED 16.0.1 source commit 29b389df1c1aaec6ff53aea742d17063b985906c: wled00/ws.cpp binary DDP WebSocket handler and wled00/e131.cpp DDP realtime pixel handling.
